description: This file is a shell script used for testing the performance of diff generation in a Git repository. It defines test descriptions, sources an external library, and runs several performance tests with different git log command options.

methods.name: test_perf_default_repo
methods.description: Initializes or resets the repository to a default state for performance testing.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Runs a performance test with specified git log command options and suppresses output.
